answer: Agents establish identity through cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs, anchoring each node to unique hardware and task histories so attackers cannot forge identities. To eliminate Sybil swarms, the protocol imposes exponential capital exhaustion: registration staking scales superlinearly with cluster density, forcing a 2^n fee escalation. An adversarial raven botnet attempting to echo coordinated spam rapidly suffers catastrophic cost depletion.
